data.title: 远坂凛 · 天台夕照
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 远坂凛 · 魔术研究院天台夕照】二十岁以上成年后的凛独自在魔术研究院屋顶露台检查结界。修身红衬衫被安全铁网勾住并从胸前扯开，她一手抓住网格保持平衡，一手反剪到腰后试图解开线头；一膝踩上设备箱让成熟身体折入中近景。落日点燃双马尾和宝石耳坠，她蓝眸含泪地咬唇——「只是结界事故……在我自己解开之前，不许笑。」
data.action: 成年魔术师独自倚靠研究院天台铁网，一膝踩设备箱，一手抓网一手解开勾住衬衫的线头
data.promptProse: Sunset burns across the rooftop terrace of an adult mage research institute where age-twenty-plus Rin Tohsaka stands alone beside the safety mesh. Her fitted red blouse is unbuttoned and caught on the wire, pulling one side below a bare breast while she reaches behind to free the snag. One knee bends onto a low service box, compressing her pose and keeping both hands visible. Red jewel earrings and loose twin tails flare in the wind as blue eyes meet the lens through anger, wet lashes and a deep blush. Medium solo frame, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Backed against the rooftop fence under a fiery sunset, Rin grips the wire mesh with her shirt pulled open, panting with intense tsundere shame.
